name: storage bench
caption: A storage bench with a seat lid over a closed box and two side panels. A slatted seat spans two framed supports; the backrest joins the rear posts. Straight slats keep a constant thickness and the frame stays square. Overall width is 2.10 times depth; height is 0.50 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous dark gray, tan, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
